output.domain: AI Cloud Data Centre Fabric Architecture
output.overview: Modern AI clusters operate two distinct network planes: Front-End (North-South/Management/Storage) and Back-End (East-West/Scale-Out Compute), complemented by Scale-Up rack domains (NVLink NVL72) and on-host networking.

frontend_network.purpose: Client ingress, Kubernetes control plane, cluster management, Out-of-Band (OOB), and high-throughput storage (NFS/Ceph/WEKA/VAST).
frontend_network.technology: Ethernet leaf-spine topology orchestrated natively by Netris using EVPN-VXLAN, VPC multi-tenancy, V-Net overlays (L2VPN/L3VPN), hardware NAT, and SoftGate L4 load balancers.
frontend_network.addressing: Dual-plane addressing: Out-of-Band management IPs (mgmtAddress) for control plane/SSH jump host access, and in-band underlay/routing loopbacks (mainAddress).

backend_network.purpose: Non-blocking, ultra-low-latency East-West accelerator interconnect for GPU-to-GPU collective operations (AllReduce, All-to-All).
backend_network.infiniband_path: Quantum-2 switches managed via the NVIDIA UFM (Unified Fabric Manager) integration plugin in Netris. Netris automates GUID discovery and PKey partition isolation declaratively per Server-Cluster.
backend_network.rocev2_ethernet_path: High-performance Ethernet (e.g., NVIDIA Spectrum-X) configured in rail-optimised planes with PFC (802.1Qbb Priority Flow Control), ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification), ETS, and Adaptive Routing.

scale_up_fabric.name: NVIDIA NVLink NVL72 / Multi-Node NVLink
scale_up_fabric.technology: Rack-scale GB200/GB300 NVL72 architectures interconnecting 72 GPUs across 9 NVLink switch trays in a full mesh.
scale_up_fabric.netris_role: Netris links into NVIDIA NMX Controller (NMX-C) via gRPC with mTLS, declaratively enforcing NVLink partitions based on Server-Cluster tenant boundaries to prevent cross-tenant GPU leakage.

on_host_networking.technology: Routing On the Host (ROH) running BGP/EVPN directly on host OS or NVIDIA BlueField DPUs, advertising host loopbacks into top-of-rack switches.
on_host_networking.acceleration: Multi-rail NIC striping, SR-IOV, GPUDirect RDMA, and PXN (PCIe Acceleration) offloads.

troubleshooting_hints: In Netris CloudSim / production environments, target switches via out-of-band management IP (mgmtAddress), not underlay loopback (mainAddress).
Server multi-tenancy across Ethernet, InfiniBand (PKeys), and NVLink (partitions) is consolidated declaratively into the Netris Server-Cluster object.
Monitor PFC pause frames and buffer occupancy to detect RoCEv2 incast congestion hotspots.

output.technology: Unified Fabric Manager (UFM) for InfiniBand fabrics
output.netris_integration: The Netris-UFM plugin automates InfiniBand tenant isolation by mapping Netris Server-Cluster objects to UFM PKeys (Partitions), port GUID memberships, and optional SHARP (Scalable Hierarchical Aggregation and Reduction Protocol) trees.
configuration_prerequisites: UFM gv.cfg must set 'default_membership = limited' under [MngNetwork] to permit programmatic REST API partition enforcement.
Netris Controller discovers port GUIDs and synchronises tenant PKey boundaries continuously.
troubleshooting_hints: Verify UFM REST API health and token credentials configured in Netris Settings -> General.
Ensure compute nodes assigned to a tenant share matching InfiniBand PKeys to allow collective communication.
Check for fabric-wide SM (Subnet Manager) master election conflicts using 'sminfo'.

output.netris_integration: Netris integrates with NVIDIA NMX-C over gRPC with mTLS to synchronise NVLink partitions across 72-GPU rack domains (GB200/GB300). Eliminates manual GPU UID ledger tracking by reconciling partitions against declared Server-Cluster assignments every 10 seconds.
architecture_details: 18 compute servers (72 GPUs total) interconnected by 9 NVLink switch trays in a full mesh.
NMX-C runs locally per rack on an NVLink switch tray.
Netris provides the single declarative source of truth for multi-tenant boundaries across Ethernet, InfiniBand, and NVLink.
troubleshooting_hints: Verify GPU inventory ledger mapping server hostnames to GPU UIDs.
Check mTLS client certificates and CA trust chain for NMX-C gRPC communication.
Confirm that compute nodes in the same Server-Cluster reside in the same NVL partition.

output.technology: Routing On the Host (ROH) & Host Networking Agents
output.overview: Netris extends cloud networking onto bare-metal hosts and hypervisors via Routing On the Host (ROH) and netris-agent, eliminating layer-2 VLAN sprawl and bridging overhead.
components: ROH: Host runs BGP unnumbered / EVPN to advertise its /32 loopbacks directly to ToR switches.
DPU Offload: NVIDIA BlueField-2/3 DPUs running ovs-doca or embedded Linux offloading overlay encapsulation.
Multi-Rail: GPU clusters bind dedicated ConnectX HCAs/NICs per rail for deterministic non-blocking communication.
troubleshooting_hints: Ensure netris-agent daemon is active: 'systemctl status netris-agent'.
Verify BGP peering status between host loopback and leaf switch: 'ip route show proto bgp'.
For RoCE workloads, verify MTU 9000 (jumbo frames) across all host and switch physical interfaces.
